name: no.razem/articles
title: Razem Norge
description: Search and read articles of Razem Norge, a Polish newspaper in Norway, as Markdown. Read-only.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search all Razem Norge articles by keywords in the title and text. Returns up to 20 matches, newest first, each with its title, URL, publication date and a short excerpt. Most articles are in Polish, so Polish keywords find the most; Norwegian terms (NAV, Skatteetaten, barnehage) work too. Use read_page on a result URL to get the full article.

query.description: Keywords to search for, e.g. "NAV zasiłek" or "podatek Skatteetaten". All words must appear in the article; use fewer words to find more.

limit.description: How many articles to return, from 1 to 20. Leave out to get 10; ask for more only when you need to compare many articles.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List every section (category) of Razem Norge, largest first, with its name, slug, URL, parent section and number of articles. Call it first to find the slug to pass to get_latest_articles, e.g. "praca-i-finanse" for work and money.

tools.name: get_latest_articles
tools.description: Get the most recently published Razem Norge articles, newest first, from the whole site or from one section and its subsections. Each article comes with its title, URL, publication date and a short excerpt. Use it for current news; use search_articles for a topic.

section.description: Slug of a section from list_sections, e.g. "wiadomosci" (news) or "zycie-w-norwegii" (life in Norway). Leave out for the whole site.

limit.description: How many articles to return, from 1 to 20. Leave out to get 10; ask for more only when you need to compare many articles.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one Razem Norge article or page in full as Markdown: the title, lead, author, publication and update dates, sections, topics and the whole text with its links. The front page URL returns an overview of the site with its sections and the latest articles.

url.description: Full URL of an article or page on https://www.razem.no/, as returned by search_articles or get_latest_articles. A path such as "/kontakt/" also works.
